Hannah (People Ops): Quick heads-up: SOC2/ISO evidence deadline is this Friday 11:59pm PT. We added a new optional fast-track reviewer lane for small teams (<=5 artifacts) to get same-day feedback.
Marco (Eng): Nice. How do we opt in for fast-track?
Hannah (People Ops): Add FASTTRACK=true in the manifest header and set reviewer_pref=fasttrack. We can't guarantee same-day if volume spikes, but we'll try.
Priya (Security): Reminder: all exported logs must include timezone (ISO 8601). If using Grafana/Kibana, choose UTC export.
Sam (Compliance): Small teams: please limit each artifact to one control mapping per file. Multi-control blobs slow audits down.
Marco (Eng): Got it. One question: are design docs acceptable as Google Doc links or do you need PDF snapshots?
Sam (Compliance): PDF snapshot preferred. If link required, include a read-only link + PDF. Links alone will be flagged.
NotifyBot: 5 days left until evidence window closes. You have 3 unsubmitted artifacts assigned.
Hannah (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 3pm PT for manifest reviews. Drop by if you want a pre-check. Also DM me for timezone exceptions.
Marco (Eng): Uploading infra artifacts now (manifest attached). Thanks folks.
Sam (Compliance): Received, starting review. Expect comments in the manifest within 48 hrs.
